description: Aliz (Big Buddy), the Meshy-rigged caregiver. The ONLY file that may name one of her bones; gameplay speaks LB_Rig_v1 socket names through pink_girl_buddy.gd::get_socket().
notes: Same rig family as meshy_baby_v01.json: 24 bones, spine chain named backwards (Spine02 lowest at 0.79 m of 1.7, Spine01 0.89, Spine 0.98 topmost), mitten hands, bones in CENTIMETRES under an Armature node carrying a 0.01 scale.

Offsets are inverseBindMatrix[bone] * targetPointInMeshSpace, mesh space being the 1.7-unit, +Z-facing space the GLB's vertices are in. Bone rest positions in that space: Hips (0, 0.70, 0), Spine (0, 0.98, -0.04), LeftHand (0.27, 0.65, 0), RightHand (-0.26, 0.68, 0), Head (0, 1.09, 0).

carryFront is where a CARRIED child's root (his feet) goes: 0.36 m up and 0.28 m in front of her in her own 1.65 m frame, hung off the hips so it rides her walk bounce without her torso lean swinging it. Measured off the meshes: her dress front reaches 0.16 m ahead of her origin at hip height and Bunny's back sits 0.07 m behind his, so 0.28 m leaves ~5 cm of air; 0.36 m up puts his hips at her hanging hands (0.63-0.66 m) and his head top at her chin. Only the socket's POSITION is used by carry_controller.gd; the child's yaw is hers.

itemHoldRight/Left reproduce kitchen_view.gd's tuned HAND_BONE_OFFSET (-0.005, 0.035, -0.06 in her frame from the wrist) so a bottle taken from the fridge renders exactly where docs/shots/world_carry_ipad.png shows it -- but bone-local, so it now closes with the mitt through the arm swing.
hugTarget is a chest-front point for anything aimed at her chest; nothing uses it yet.
